segments.name: Summerhouse remote resilience & energy
segments.thesis: 236k+ summerhouses plus affluent/remote owners create persistent frost, outage, water and energy-control jobs, but Denmark already has unusually sophisticated niche specialists; only interoperability/exact-system gaps deserve testing.
falsifiers: combined-system integration does not create purchase intent

segments.name: Heat-pump lifecycle / exact compatibility
segments.thesis: Heat-pump heated dwellings and 2025 sales are growing rapidly, creating future lifecycle demand; generic systems/accessories are already mature, so opportunity must be exact model/adapter/obsolete-part friction.
falsifiers: cross-brand spare specialists fully cover Danish lifecycle needs

segments.name: Emerging EV model aftermarket
segments.thesis: BEV stock grew 49.6% YoY and used-EV transactions are rising. Generic Tesla is saturated; the testable edge is newly scaling non-Tesla model cohorts whose Danish accessory depth lags Germany/Sweden.
falsifiers: new-model accessory supply appears simultaneously with registrations

segments.name: Distributed energy retrofit / monitoring
segments.thesis: 162k+ grid-connected solar installations and high electric-asset penetration create monitoring, storage and retrofit compatibility jobs, but generic solar hardware should be assumed mature until merchant lag is proven.

segments.name: Wood/pellet installed base
segments.thesis: Large wood/pellet installed base creates replacement needs, but Denmark already has deep model-specific spare-parts commerce; retain as a negative/reference ecosystem rather than generic launch thesis.
falsifiers: a narrow model family has no viable Danish spares
new regulation creates a specific measurement/replacement gap

segments.name: Dynamic-price energy control
segments.thesis: EV/heat-pump/solar households plus open price/system data create a control/interoperability layer, but 4Power already proves strong local execution; opportunity may be integration-specific rather than generic hardware.
falsifiers: hardware retrofit requires electrician in all cases
no willingness to pay beyond energy apps

ecosystems.name: Summerhouse remote resilience / energy
ecosystems.definition: Danish summerhouses and remote-use holiday homes requiring frost, power, water, heat and energy control while unoccupied.
ecosystems.next_action: Join summerhouse density to DMI frost/precipitation and measure exact fail-safe/interoperability queries; do not launch generic alarm or heat-pump advice.

ecosystems.name: Heat-pump lifecycle / compatibility
ecosystems.definition: Growing Danish heat-pump installed base with future maintenance, adapter, controller and old-model part jobs; generic product sales already mature.
falsifiers: Danish cross-brand spares fully cover lifecycle
ecosystems.next_action: Extract Danish heat-pump make/model/age proxies; build exact part compatibility graph; measure old-model/controller queries before requesting dealer terms.

ecosystems.name: Emerging EV model aftermarket
ecosystems.definition: Fast-growing BEV stock and used-EV circulation; search for model cohorts whose accessory/maintenance commerce lags registrations, excluding saturated Tesla generic products.
falsifiers: new-model merchants appear as fast as registrations
ecosystems.next_action: Pull StatBank exact make/model cohorts monthly; identify high-growth models excluding Tesla; freeze universe then measure Danish merchant/query lag.

ecosystems.name: Distributed solar / storage retrofit
ecosystems.definition: Existing solar/self-consumption systems creating monitoring, battery and inverter-compatibility retrofit jobs.
ecosystems.next_action: Map inverter/battery installed cohorts and price-data interoperability; measure exact retrofit queries and merchant coverage.

ecosystems.name: Wood/pellet heating installed base
ecosystems.definition: Large residential/holiday-home wood and pellet installed base retained as a negative-control ecosystem because specialist replacement commerce is already deep.
falsifiers: specific old models show genuine unserved exact-part demand
ecosystems.next_action: Use as negative training case; only reopen exact model families after measured demand + zero-good-seller evidence.

ecosystems.name: Dynamic-price home/summerhouse control
ecosystems.definition: Control layer combining electricity prices with heat pumps, EVs, solar, spas and remote properties.
falsifiers: existing energy apps/4Power cover dominant needs
ecosystems.next_action: Enumerate SG Ready/Modbus/vendor protocol gaps not supported by incumbent products; measure exact compatibility queries.
